title: Taien Ng-Chan
about: Taien Ng-Chan is a writer and media artist whose work explores location, sound, and futurist imaginings of everyday life through immersive cinema. She is a professor in Cinema & Media Arts at York University, and York Research Chair in Marginal & Emergent Media.

title: Haoran Chang
about: Haoran Chang is a multidisciplinary artist and designer whose practice spans interactive media, installation, and digital art. He is passionate about exploring the intersection of technology and human experience through innovative design solutions.
